name: Nordsol bio-LNG plant, Amsterdam (Nordsol/Shell/Renewi)
description: 3,400 t/yr bio-LNG plus 6,800 t/yr liquid bio-CO2; feedstock is biogas from Renewi waste processing; opened 15 Oct 2021 - the first bio-LNG plant in the Netherlands

sources.note: Bioenergy news, 15 Oct 2021 (opening, 3.4 kt/yr, Nordsol-Shell-Renewi); Nordsol factsheet (European Biogas Association); read 2026-10-28
